description: Daily vessel transits through the Suez Canal, counted by ship type (container, dry bulk, general cargo, ro-ro, tanker) with capacity, from IMF PortWatch (AIS-derived). Transit counts only; the latest date lags real time by about a week. Related tools on this server, for a different need: logistics_panama_canal_transits when you need Daily vessel transits through the Panama Canal chokepoint. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

days.description: How many most recent days, 1 to 30 (default 7)
